test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the simple interest on a principal of Rs. 2250 for 5 years at the rate of 6 percent per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 2250

Rate of interest (R) = 3%

Time period (T) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (S.I) = (P × T × R) /100

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (S.I) = (2250 × 5 × 6)/100 = Rs. 675

**∴ The interest is 675.**
